issue: independent p27w CompletionTests.test_done_that_does_not_reach_the_manager_keeps_the_worker_busy fixes the pre-R1 behaviour (unknown report -> worker stays busy), which review finding R1 (P1) required to change
decision: R1 is the intended behaviour: a report whose delivery outcome is unknown before acceptance closes the Task as report_outcome_unknown, frees the worker and is announced in the manager's next tool notices; nothing is resent. The test is corrected to assert that rule (worker free, Task closed report_outcome_unknown, no resend, notice present); its no-replay invariant stays.
